title: In Vitro and in Silico Investigation of DNA Interaction, Topoisomerase I and II Inhibitory Properties of Polydatin.
authors: Sohretoglu, Didem; Barut, Burak; Sari, Suat; Ozel, Arzu; Kuruuzum-Uz, Ayse; Arroo, Randolph
one_liner_zh: 该文通过体外实验和分子对接研究白藜芦醇苷与DNA及拓扑异构酶II的相互作用，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（拓扑异构酶-DNA复合物）且含分子对接方法，但对象非典型TF-DNA体系，深度有限。
abstract: Polydatin or piceid, is the 3-O-glucoside of resveratrol and is found abundantly in grapes, peanuts, wine, beer, and cacao products. Although anticancer activity of polydatin was reported before, and potential antiproliferative mechanisms of polydatin have been proposed, its direct effects on DNA and inhibitory potential against topoisomerase enzymes have remained unknown. In this study we aimed to reveal the link between polydatin's effects on DNA and DNA-topoisomerases and its antiproliferative promise. For this purpose, we evaluated the effects of polydatin on DNA and DNA topoisomerase using in vitro and in silico techniques. Polydatin was found to protect DNA against Fenton reaction-induced damage while not showing any hydrolytic nuclease effect. Further, polydatin inhibited topoisomerase II but not topoisomerase I. According to molecular docking studies, polydatin preferably showed minor groove binding to DNA where the stilbene moiety was important for binding to the DNA-topoisomerase II complex. As a result, topoisomerase II inhibition might be another anticancer mechanism of polydatin.
abstract_zh: 虎杖苷（polydatin）或云杉苷（piceid）是白藜芦醇的3-O-葡萄糖苷，在葡萄、花生、葡萄酒、啤酒和可可制品中含量丰富。尽管此前已有报道虎杖苷具有抗癌活性，并提出了其潜在的抗增殖机制，但其对DNA的直接作用及对拓扑异构酶（topoisomerase）的抑制潜力仍属未知。本研究旨在揭示虎杖苷对DNA及DNA-拓扑异构酶的作用与其抗增殖潜力之间的联系。为此，我们采用体外（in vitro）和计算机模拟（in silico）技术评估了虎杖苷对DNA和DNA拓扑异构酶的影响。研究发现，虎杖苷能保护DNA免受Fenton反应诱导的损伤，同时未表现出任何水解性核酸酶效应。此外，虎杖苷抑制拓扑异构酶II，但不抑制拓扑异构酶I。根据分子对接（molecular docking）研究，虎杖苷优先与DNA的小沟结合，其中二苯乙烯（stilbene）部分对结合DNA-拓扑异构酶II复合物至关重要。因此，拓扑异构酶II抑制可能是虎杖苷的另一种抗癌机制。
